# 13 UTOPiA

> Digital marketing, SEO, web development, CGI video, ORM, and email marketing agency in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.

## About

13 UTOPiA (also written 13 Utopia / 13UTOPIA) is a full-service digital agency based in Scarborough (Toronto), Ontario, Canada. The team helps brands win organic search, run paid acquisition, ship conversion-focused websites, produce CGI advertising creatives, protect online reputation, and automate email revenue.

## Contact

- Phone: +1 437-603-9004
- Office: 30 Kimbercroft Ct, Scarborough, ON M1S 4K9, Canada (Markham Corners)

## Services

- [Search Engine Optimization](https://13utopia.ca/search-engine-optimization): technical SEO, content, and authority to grow qualified organic traffic
- [Digital Marketing](https://13utopia.ca/digital-marketing): paid search/social, funnels, and performance creative
- [Web Development](https://13utopia.ca/web-development): fast, SEO-ready custom websites
- [CGI Videos](https://13utopia.ca/cgi-videos): 3D / CGI advertising and brand films
- [Online Reputation Management](https://13utopia.ca/online-reputation-management): monitoring, SERP defense, review strategy
- [Email Marketing](https://13utopia.ca/email-marketing): lifecycle campaigns and automation
